Container.Name: framewrk
Container.Overview:
Framewrk keeps your Aura and Nixplay digital photo frames filled from your own PhotoPrism and/or Immich library.
Point it at PhotoPrism, Immich, or both, add the frames you own, and it uploads the photos that match your rules on a schedule — at the right size and shape for each screen — and takes them back off when they no longer qualify. It remembers what it has already sent, so nothing is uploaded twice. Portrait and landscape frames each get what suits them.
Nothing needs configuring before the first start. Open the console on port 8770, sign in with the one-time password printed in the container log, and set everything up there.
Send directly from the Framewrk iOS app or Photos Share Sheet without a photo library. Direct photos are independent of library rules, with delivery history and revocable device tokens.
All state is one SQLite file under /data, so a backup is one file.
Immich 3.1 or newer is supported; configure its URL and an API key in the console. Its optional star rating is used by the shared Quality rule. Requires an Aura and/or Nixplay account. Library sync also requires a reachable PhotoPrism and/or Immich server. Free to use; not open source. Not affiliated with Aura, Nixplay, PhotoPrism or Immich.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: photoprism immich aura nixplay photo frame digital picture frame sync ios share upload
Container.Requires: An Aura and/or Nixplay account. PhotoPrism or Immich is optional for direct uploads.
Container.Changes:
### 1.2.0
- Add direct photo uploads to Aura and Nixplay without a photo library. Durable jobs, per-frame delivery status, retry handling, and duplicate protection keep explicit sends independent of PhotoPrism and Immich cleanup. - Add the Framewrk iPhone/iPad app and Photos Share Extension, with background uploads, frame selection, delivery history, and secure device tokens. - Add Direct sends and connected devices to the console. Include direct photos in Wall previews and counts, and support revoking a phone without changing frame-service credentials. - Bound uploaded image size, queue storage, image retention, and vendor request timeouts. Disclose Nixplay albums shared by multiple frames.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Port for the Framewrk console. Change the host side if 8770 is already taken.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Holds sync.db — the settings, the frame list and the sync history. Back this folder up and you have backed up the whole installation.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Your timezone as a tz database name, for example America/New_York. Without it every timestamp in the log and the console is UTC.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container writes as. 99 is Unraid's nobody. Leave it alone unless you know you need otherwise.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the container writes as. 100 is Unraid's users group.
